faqs.a:
Any member who attains the age of 55 years and who is otherwise eligible for retirement
               may be continued in service for periods not to extend beyond his attainment of age
               60 years; provided, such continuance in service is:
(1)
Requested by him in writing; and
(2)
Recommended by the chief of police and approved by the city manager. Upon his retirement
                  he shall be entitled to a pension provided for in
section 86-151
. In no event shall a member be retained in service beyond the age of 60 years.
(Code 1960, § 19-8; Code 1981, § 26-62)
State Law reference—
Retirement pension under statutory system, C.R.S. § 31-30-610.
